gaps.finding: 2019 public ranges are pinned, not verified latest installed device settings.
gaps.action: keep revision; real deployment needs local profile verification

gaps.finding: Six percentage intervals absent from pinned table; result support exists.
gaps.action: commercial profile records no-interval; demo has explicit synthetic bounds

gaps.finding: Cat PDW is N/A, including the result, not merely the interval.
gaps.action: commercial profile unsupported; demo PDW is a different explicit profile

gaps.finding: Guide p32 says 200 µL for microtainers; p51 says minimum 90 µL dependent on manufacturer.
gaps.action: do not set a universal microtube default; standard tube minimum 500 µL is not a target draw volume

gaps.finding: Display range is not analytical range; UI decimals are prototype policy.
gaps.action: preserve raw input and source qualification; critical limits not invented

gaps.finding: Independent requested output does not imply independent physical measurement.
gaps.action: keep supporting measurements on execution attempt; do not silently order/charge them

gaps.finding: No live-schema audit or price policy implemented.
gaps.action: LAB-03 audits required fields; later explicit workspace prices, no automatic retest charge
